artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12, additionalProperties false at every level; filer by principal_id and user_type only; pdf_ref and commentary_ref nullable, report_ref and original_ref non-null. Committed LOCAL on wk-IRPT_ANLREQ-341. Nothing deployed.

AMENDMENT 1: audit_address and write_audit go through lib/opal_naming reporting_destination (ANALYSIS_AUDIT, policy irpt-anlreq-x10-v1): product bucket opal-data-irpt, key irpt/<firm>/platinum/analysis_audit/ART-<sha256(request_id)>/<sha256(request_id)>.json (a stable name, so a replace writes the same key). build_audit_record, validate (ValidationUnavailable when jsonschema is not importable), write_audit (validate first, one put through the injected port). A refused family is AddressRefused. Committed LOCAL. Nothing run against AWS.

handle_commentary_ready attaches exactly as before (the body is _attach_commentary, unchanged in behaviour) and then calls _write_audit once; the audit outcome rides in the result's audit field and an audit failure never raises. An AddressRefused is AUDIT_REFUSED:AUDIT_ADDRESS_REFUSED. The audit ports are OPTIONAL and absent in every existing caller (AUDIT_PORTS_UNWIRED). Committed LOCAL.

16 offline tests: good record to the reporting-destination pair; four missing linkages; jsonschema unavailable; email refused; commentary-null admitted and report null refused; one write from the packager; audit failure leaves the attach; unwired ports; replace attach keeps one (bucket, key) pair; the real registry row without the family refuses (AddressRefused); key depends on request id only. Committed LOCAL.
AC1 checker: meta-validates the schema, admits the good sample, rejects the four one-linkage-missing samples. jsonschema imported under python -I here (measured), so no minimal checker was needed.

AC3 checker: reads opal_packager.py by AST (no import, no side effect); counts the writer call sites (must be 1), requires the audit helper to be called once in handle_commentary_ready and after the attach call.
Mutant control for AC3: three in-memory mutants of the packager text (audit helper twice; audit helper before the attach; writer twice) each read BAD, the real text reads OK.
